description: This file defines a React context and hook for managing the state of a kanban board, including columns and cards. It handles fetching data from a Supabase backend, real-time updates via subscriptions, and UI-only state management such as archiving columns. The code also provides functions for CRUD operations on columns and cards, bulk insertion, CSV synchronization, and local storage persistence for archiving state.

methods.name: safeLoadArchivedColumnIds()
methods.description: Loads archived column IDs from localStorage, parsing JSON and returning a set of IDs or an empty set on failure.

methods.name: safeSaveArchivedColumnIds(idSet)
methods.description: Saves the set of archived column IDs to localStorage as a JSON string, errors are caught and ignored.

methods.name: useKanban()
methods.description: Custom React hook that provides access to the kanban context.

methods.name: fetchAll
methods.description: Fetches all columns and cards data from the Supabase backend, updating local state.

methods.name: addColumn
methods.description: Adds a new column with the provided title, assigning position based on existing columns.

methods.name: updateColumn
methods.description: Updates a column's attributes, ignoring 'is_archived' property to keep it UI-only.

methods.name: archiveColumn
methods.description: Marks a column as archived in the UI-only state.

methods.name: unarchiveColumn
methods.description: Removes a column from the archived UI state.

methods.name: deleteColumn
methods.description: Deletes a column from the backend and clears its archived state locally.

methods.name: reorderColumns
methods.description: Reorders columns based on an array of id-position mappings, updating positions in the database.

methods.name: addCard
methods.description: Adds a new card to a specified column with sequential position.

methods.name: deleteCard
methods.description: Deletes a card from the backend and updates local state, with error handling.

methods.name: reorderCardsInColumn
methods.description: Reorders cards within a column based on provided id-position array.

methods.name: bulkInsertCards
methods.description: Inserts multiple cards into a column in bulk, assigning sequential positions and handling errors.

methods.name: syncCardsFromCsv
methods.description: Synchronizes cards from CSV text input, via a shared flow, then refreshes state.
